proposed.title: Catch OSError during ZoneInfo string validation

proposed.body:

Root cause: pydantic/_internal/_validators.py:validate_str_is_valid_iana_tz caught (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError, TypeError) but omitted OSError when instantiating ZoneInfo(value).

Constraints: Applies when initializing ZoneInfo from raw string inputs where filesystem-backed timezone lookups can fail; does not apply to already-constructed ZoneInfo instances.

proposed.title: Separate timedelta serialization mode from temporal mode in inference
answers: Why does ser_json_timedelta change datetime or date serialization formatting in dump_json?

Constraints: Applies when resolving deprecated type-specific serialization flags alongside broader group settings; does not apply to explicit type serializers that directly inspect their own configuration.

proposed.title: Catch OverflowError in ByteSize validation
answers: Why does ByteSize raise an unhandled OverflowError on huge string values?
How to handle OverflowError when validating large string inputs in ByteSize?

proposed.body:
Symptom: Validating a ByteSize field from a string with an excessively large numeric value crashes with an unhandled OverflowError instead of a ValidationError.
Root cause: pydantic/types.py:ByteSize converts the scalar using float(scalar) * unit_mult without catching float OverflowError.
Fix pattern: Wrap numeric string conversions in try/except OverflowError and reraise as PydanticCustomError to ensure proper ValidationError reporting.
Constraints: Applies to string parsing into float scalars; does not apply to direct integer inputs which support arbitrary precision in Python.

proposed.title: Copy class namespace before iteration to avoid free-threaded race conditions
answers: Why does TypeAdapter or model inspection raise RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration in Python 3.14?
How do I safely iterate over class attributes or vars(typ) in free-threaded Python?
What causes concurrent annotation evaluation crashes in LazyLocalNamespace or decorator extraction?
proposed.body:
Symptom: RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration when building TypeAdapter instances or constructing models concurrently in free-threaded Python 3.14+.
Root cause: pydantic/_internal/_decorators.py:_decorator_infos_for_class and pydantic/_internal/_namespace_utils.py:LazyLocalNamespace.data iterate over vars(typ) or MappingProxyType namespaces while another thread evaluates annotations, mutating the class dictionary with attributes like __annotations_cache__.
Fix pattern: Snapshot the mapping via .copy() prior to iteration (e.g. vars(typ).copy().items() or ns.copy() if isinstance(ns, MappingProxyType) else ns).
Constraints: Applies to class namespaces and types where concurrent annotation reads can mutate class attributes; unnecessary for thread-confined local dictionaries.
proposed.applies: Class namespace inspection and attribute iteration in free-threaded Python environments.

proposed.title: Set model mocks instead of deleting attributes during force rebuild
answers: Why does concurrent BaseModel.model_rebuild(force=True) cause race conditions with model instantiation?
How to reset core schema, validator, and serializer during model rebuild without breaking thread safety?
How do I invalidate a BaseModel without delattr race conditions in free-threaded builds?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Instantiating a model while another thread runs model_rebuild(force=True) resolves uncompleted parent attributes or fails due to missing schema attributes.
Root cause: pydantic/main.py:BaseModel.model_rebuild used delattr on core schema, validator, and serializer attributes, exposing an incomplete unmocked window where concurrent readers fall back to parent class definitions.
Fix pattern: Call _mock_val_ser.set_model_mocks(cls) on already complete models rather than deleting attributes via delattr.
Constraints: Applies when invalidating or rebuilding existing models (when already_complete is True); initial model construction handles mock initialization through the metaclass.
proposed.applies: BaseModel schema rebuilding under concurrent or free-threaded execution.

proposed.title: Handling base class deferral in Mypy plugin during import cycles
answers: Why does Mypy report unexpected keyword argument errors on a Pydantic subclass when there is an import cycle?
How does the Pydantic Mypy plugin handle circular imports between base and child models?
Why does the Mypy plugin fail to collect inherited fields from a base model during circular imports?
Why is Mypy crashing when two Pydantic models import each other?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Mypy crashes or reports false-positive unexpected keyword argument errors on model subclasses when models reference each other in an import cycle.
Root cause: pydantic/mypy.py:PydanticModelTransformer.collect_fields_and_class_vars skipped base classes whose processing was deferred in import cycles because METADATA_KEY was not yet populated, finalizing subclasses without inherited fields.
Fix pattern: Tag model TypeInfo metadata at start of transformation, detect tagged but incomplete base classes during ancestor inspection, and defer subclass processing via api.defer() for another pass.
Constraints: Applies to Mypy AST type-checking passes where class dependencies resolve out of order; deferral must check not api.final_iteration to prevent infinite analysis loops.
proposed.applies: Pydantic Mypy plugin model transformation when resolving base class fields across import cycles

proposed.title: Preserve include/exclude filters when function serializer falls back
answers: Why does model_dump(include=...) or model_dump(exclude=...) not work with model_serializer(when_used='json')?
How to prevent include and exclude from being dropped when a custom serializer falls back?
model_dump ignores exclude or include parameters when when_used condition is not met
proposed.body:
Symptom: Calling model_dump() with include or exclude ignores the filters when a model has a model_serializer configured with when_used='json'.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/type_serializers/function.rs:function_type_serializer cleared include/exclude unconditionally, dropping user filters even when the serializer was skipped and fallback was called.
Fix pattern: Check whether the serializer function executed or fell back; clear include/exclude only when the function executed, and preserve state.include_exclude() on fallback.
Constraints: Applies to function serializers with fallback logic; when the custom function actually executes, include/exclude must still be cleared because the function handles its own filtering.

answers: Why does Field(discriminator=...) fail on a PEP 695 TypeAliasType union?

Constraints: Applies to definition-ref resolution in discriminated union conversion; raises MissingDefinitionForUnionRef if the definition reference cannot be resolved.

answers: Why does comparing SecretStr with non-ASCII characters raise TypeError?

Fix pattern: Encode strings to bytes with .encode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass') before passing them to secrets.compare_digest().
Constraints: Applies when using secrets.compare_digest() on unicode strings that may contain non-ASCII characters or lone surrogates; not needed for raw bytes or SecretBytes.
